name: mova-rdc
description: MOVA RDC — plateforme de mobilité microservices

scripts.build:services: npm run build:shared && npm run build --prefix services/auth-service && npm run build --prefix services/ride-service && npm run build --prefix services/payment-service && npm run build --prefix services/driver-service && npm run build --prefix services/notification-service && npm run build --prefix services/admin-service && npm run build --prefix services/api-gateway
scripts.test:gateway: npm test --prefix services/api-gateway && npm run test:e2e --prefix services/api-gateway
scripts.migrate:all: npm run prisma:deploy --prefix services/auth-service && npm run prisma:deploy --prefix services/ride-service && npm run prisma:deploy --prefix services/payment-service && npm run prisma:deploy --prefix services/driver-service && npm run prisma:deploy --prefix services/notification-service
